etymologies.etymologyHTML: From agriculture +‎ -al.

quote.citation: 2004, Monty Armstrong, David Daniel, Abby Kanarek, Cracking the AP World History Exam, 2004-2005, The Princeton Review, page 328:
quote.text: The Neolithic Revolution (about 8000-3000 B.C.E.) was characterized by people moving from nomadic lifestyles to agricultural lifestyles.

definitions.definition: (cricket) As if played with a scythe.
A product or commodity from agriculture.

quote.citation: 2008, Adam Dunsby, John Eckstein, Jess Gaspar, Commodity Investing:
quote.text: In what follows we divide commodities into three group—energy, metals, and agriculturals—and use equity indexes that are sensible for each commodity group.
